name: Welcome Back to the Dungeon
summary: Push-your-luck bidding game where players dare the last bidder to survive a dungeon with shrinking equipment.
rules_text: A round uses one adventurer with 6 equipment tiles giving HP and monster immunities, and a shuffled 13-card monster deck. All players share the adventurer. Clockwise bidding: on your turn draw the top monster secretly and either add it face-down to the central dungeon pile, or place it face-down before you and discard one remaining equipment tile onto it; if no equipment remains you must add to dungeon. Alternatively pass and sit out the round. If deck empties you must pass. When all but one have passed, that player enters the dungeon. Sum adventurer HP plus remaining equipment HP. Reveal dungeon cards one by one: if equipment defeats that monster type, discard it with no damage, otherwise lose HP equal to its strength. If total damage is less than starting HP you gain a success. Two successes wins. If you fail you flip your aid to wounded; second failure eliminates you. Last player remaining wins. Next round shuffle monsters and winner picks next adventurer.
rating_reason: Bidding push-your-luck, bluffing who enters dungeon.
